# Screenshot Description: Transit Timetable / Live Metro Countdown

## Overview
A mobile transit app (Google Maps–style) showing a "Timetable" bottom sheet with a live countdown to the next metro arrival at a station. A map is partially visible behind the top edge of the sheet.

---

## Sections (Top to Bottom)

### 1. Map Background (top edge only)
- A map sliver visible at top with light beige/white land, blue water (top-right), green park areas, thin road outlines, and the label **"Tirupati"**.
- The white bottom sheet overlays it with large rounded top corners (~24px radius).

### 2. Sheet Header
- **Left:** Circular light-gray button with a black **X (close)** icon.
- **Center:** Title **"Timetable"** — bold, dark gray/black, ~20sp.
- **Right:** Circular light-gray button with a black **refresh** icon.
- Background: white.

### 3. Illustration
- 3D-render of a **white metro/train car** with black windows and pantograph on roof, sitting on a gray track line spanning the sheet width.

### 4. Arrival Headline
- Centered text: **"Metro arrives at Meenambakkam"** — bold, near-black, two lines, ~24sp.

### 5. Live Countdown (key element)
- Large **digital/pixel (7-segment) font** timer: **"01:13"** in **green (#1E8E3E-ish)**, with faint ghost segments visible behind digits (like an LED display).
- Implied functionality: counting down minutes:seconds to arrival.

### 6. Arrival Time Caption
- Centered gray text: **"Metro arrives at 🕐 11:54 AM"** with a small clock icon, ~16sp, medium weight.

### 7. Schedule Card (rounded rectangle, white with subtle shadow)
- **Header:** Bold "11:37 AM - 11:54 AM"
- **Subtext (gray):** "Metros arrive every 7 minutes during this period."
- **Timeline visualization:**
  - Horizontal row of **circular train-icon chips**: past trains in **gray**, upcoming trains in **light blue with dark blue icons** (overlapping pairs).
  - Below: tick-mark ruler; a **red tick** marks the current time.
  - **Time axis labels:** 11:15, 11:30, 11:4…, 0 (occluded), 12:15, 1…
  - A **yellow pill tooltip** with clock icon shows **"11:53"** (current time marker) overlapping the axis.

### 8. Second Card (partially cut off at bottom)
- Left **blue vertical accent bar** (~4px).
- Bold text: **"11:37 AM - 11:54 AM"**
- Right side: rounded gray pill with green text **"07"** (partially visible — likely headway/frequency in minutes).

### 9. Bottom Navigation
- **Not visible** in this screenshot — the expanded bottom sheet covers it. (In the full app this maps screen would normally have a search bar, directions, and nav rail.)

---

## Color Palette
| Element | Color |
|---|---|
| Sheet/card background | White |
| Header buttons | Light gray circles (#EEE) |
| Primary text | Near-black / dark gray |
| Secondary text | Mid gray |
| Countdown digits | Green (~#188038) |
| Upcoming train chips | Light blue bg, dark blue icon |
| Past train chips | Light gray |
| Current-time tick | Red/orange |
| Current-time pill | Yellow (#FDE293-ish) with dark text |
| Accent bar / card 2 | Blue (left bar), green ("07") |

## Functionality Summary
- **Live vehicle tracking:** real-time countdown to next metro arrival.
- **Timetable/headway display:** service interval info ("every 7 minutes") per time window.
- **Interactive timeline:** past vs. upcoming departures, current-time indicator, draggable/scrollable time axis.
- **Refresh** control to re-fetch live data; **close** to dismiss the sheet.

No ticket booking UI is shown — this is a schedule/live-arrivals view.
